policy: Unlaunched/internal-only: migrate owned callers and content, then delete obsolete APIs and schema readers. This inventory expands the task without changing the full three-phase goal. Root is the sole writer; three independent reviewers supplied read-only evidence.

items.title: Require exact local record framing/layout; migrate retained Scrapyard files
items.notes: One retained pre-envelope settings v3 file migrated with backup and semantic readback. Ten current profile records left untouched.
validation: Removed implicit zero-fill/truncation and require exact envelope consumption. Three kitsave tests pass with different-size layouts, every truncated prefix, oversized declarations and trailing bytes.
Migrated retained historical Scrapyard settings v3 to current RECD using archived source semantics and the actual current Settings decoder; preserved backup and all ten current profile files.
Installed SDK Scrapyard solo/duo/vault persistence checks pass.

items.title: Require current WELCOME routing flag and bump admission revision
items.notes: Current writer always sends the flag. Complete-prefix rejection and 74 session tests pass; real game join qualification remains.
validation: PROTOCOL_REV=14; required routing flag is preflighted before committing roster state.
All 74 kitsession tests pass, including the formerly exempt final-byte truncation. Updated SDK Scrapyard joins pass.

items.title: Remove former play.Trail aliases; retain kit/combat implementation
items.notes: No executable owned caller uses the old path. Final author-surface/docs checks remain.
validation: Deleted play/trail.odin aliases, kept kit/combat implementation, updated guides/comments.
Author-surface gate, Kit wasm checks, current addon build and Scrapyard builds pass.

items.title: Require exact type registration for typed lane input
items.notes: Migrate unstamped hand-built fixtures; retain explicit raw class-ID input.
validation: Removed size-only lookup and orphan CMD_ARGS_MAX alias. Updated 38 lane fixtures and four physics integration fixtures to register exact types.
All 58 kitsim tests pass, including missing-type and same-size wrong-type assertions. Nine Kit physics, four paired framework and five presentation tests pass.

items.title: Remove old control-channel config/fallback; require separate control stream
items.notes: Owned signaling relay preserves SDP metadata; current browser and rejection paths qualified.
validation: Removed legacy_control and per-peer channel fallback; require control_stream=1 in offers/answers and all three channels ready; controls only accepted on channel 2.
Actual Chrome peers pass fragmentation/credit traffic, departure/replacement/restart and gameplay convergence. Missing control capability is rejected in both offer and answer directions.

items.title: Standardize borrowed method inputs and remove compatibility option boilerplate
items.notes: Owned return lifetime remains explicit; all inputs use one borrowed convention. Fresh installed SDK tested in Scrapyard.
validation: Methods and all property setters now borrow inputs; generated wrappers always release builtin copies. Removed borrowed_args option/field and redundant annotations, retaining an actionable rejection diagnostic and owned_return.
Migrated six explicit argument frees and checked setter/signal retention sites. New tests prove input-as-borrowed-return, direct-method retention and unannotated-setter retention.
Full scriptgen gate, three editor-source tests and actual editor template/callback/runtime gate pass. Native and real Chrome lifetime tests pass; native repeated-string growth is zero.
Slopball, Slopball3D and Quickdraw UI/profile checks pass. Installed SDK Scrapyard duo/spray transfer plus three scene lifecycles with chat and file-picker calls pass.
Quickdraw final WASM check had one empty-log compiler SIGSEGV. An identical standalone check passed without source/test changes; preserve as a toolchain-flake observation for final qualification.

items.title: Emit only current authoring schema; delete schema-1 hash/build paths
items.notes: Make constructor current-only, migrate editor extraction/gizmo data and fixtures, rebake generated artifacts. No checked-in b3authoring artifacts found by review.
validation: Deleted schema1 support/hash projection/build branch and made scene_input_default(namespace) current-only. Editor/Gizmo emit current schema with empty motion arrays. No retained b3authoring artifacts found in owned example/Scrapyard source trees; fixtures/artifacts regenerated.
Thirty-four authoring/motion/artifact/framework unit checks pass, including current recovery3 construction and old-schema rejection.

Real Godot authoring and eight-family motion transactions pass .tres/.tscn roundtrips and source-free construction. Actual editor Inspector/Gizmo, single-body preview, artifact importer, runtime and detached Kit/Replay frame rendering pass.
Migrated active Dockyard old-provider test adapter to the current shared schema while preserving its deliberately different provider identity; rounds package type-checks.

items.title: Reject explicitly old capacity schemas while keeping current defaults
items.notes: Checked-in capacity profile already current. Omitted current fields/schema remain useful defaults.
validation: Removed explicit schema1 promotion; partial current profiles still receive defaults. Seven capacity-profile tests pass.
Rebuilt the native backend coherently after the loader changed; all 14 registered native checks pass. Actual SDK/Godot tests use the new shared library and manifest.

items.title: Unify native recovery formats on current format 3
items.notes: Native recovery now has one current format (3). Primitive and authored catalog conveniences share one constructor, identical identity/bytes, all joint families, alias validation and exact primitive allocation cost. Removed format-1/2 codecs, version-selecting APIs/constants and versioned descriptor names; descriptor ABI remains 2. Updated desktop/web domain admission and deployment metadata; independent reference vectors/generator and active callers use current contracts.
validation: All 14 native Release CTest checks pass, including exact constructor identity/byte parity, every joint family, old-header rejection, primitive near-budget controls and malformed/ownership failure checks.
Executed WebScalar and WebSIMD backend suites pass eight actual C programs plus independent reference parser each.
46 Odin recovery/authoring/Kit/Replay/diagnostics tests, 4 framework ownership tests with native pending-end probe, and 14 motion tests pass. Native and WASM diagnostic golden vectors match.

Actual Godot authored fixture builds/imports/reloads and destroys source data successfully. Ordinary Web export passes Chrome recovery, source-free continuation, 70,000 owner cycles and engine shutdown.

No tracked native save binaries or candidates in the scoped standard user-data locations required migration. Per-run binary fixtures regenerate from current inputs; historical build/report evidence remains unchanged.

items.title: Migrate current acceptance archives; delete content42-50 upgrade stack
items.notes: Migrated 13 checkpoints (including two diagnostics copies) and four recordings using a private frozen source build. Seventeen repository fixtures published with historical originals/receipts; the native workbench recording was atomically migrated with backup. The existing current native profile was unchanged. Deleted game-specific upgrade/revision schema packages and converter CLIs.
validation: Every checkpoint passed full typed source decode, reviewed historical defaults, explicit false-dash control mapping, target encode/decode and metadata/ledger comparison. Asset records/payloads remained byte-identical. True legacy dash and corrupt source were refused.

All four recordings preserve copied base/expected frames, input decisions and event IDs/payloads/boundaries. Source and target simulation verification passed; expected results were never regenerated. Current native/WASM verification of the three retained network recordings passes corruption, forged-state and invalid-input rejection.
Eight current plain/spray/captured fixtures resume in fresh Godot processes with exact public hash/tick, asset restoration and continued combat. Source bytes remain unchanged.

Independent evolution tests now use small synthetic schemas while preserving exact freeze/contract/scaffold checks, unreviewed-default refusal and changed-leaf detection. Six tests and current Catalog/World/Control/Action contract export pass.

Catalog exporter/runtime baker/stock reader now share content.SEMANTIC independently of the gameplay/control identity. A real Godot rebake and source receipt check pass; the canonical catalog value digest is unchanged.

items.title: Remove scheduled dash compatibility field and update game identity
items.notes: Removed Control.dash and its pre-movement execution path. All dashes use Action.Dash with ten future movement ticks. Gameplay content advanced to 0x525343524150304c; only false legacy controls were migrated.
validation: All 108 current Scrapyard model tests pass, including nonempty hit-history/pending-action roundtrips, explicit and automatic profiles, bundle-only storage, action dash timing and correction behavior.

Active-dash restore matches uninterrupted position/timers/count, preserves and settles the queued Ready sequence, changes the ready flag and emits exactly one matching action result in each continuation.
Four Stormcaller and seven Turret tests pass; migrated saved catalogs retain zero pulse/turret additions rather than silently acquiring current stock definitions. Scrapyard wasm model check passes.

items.title: Migrate profile-v1 data once; remove automatic old-record decoder
items.notes: Migrated the retained profile-v1 fixture to the current profile-v2 codec, removed Legacy_Record/content fallback, and verified the native user profile was already current and byte-identical. Identity and explicit/automatic choices are preserved.
validation: Current fixture decode matches pinned identity, epoch/tick, automatic=0, look2/iron1/abilities5+1 and cores7/parts2; roundtrip and wrong-identity checks pass. Original v1 bytes now reject without retaining its schema type.
Private native user files are backed up under the migration workspace; after all tests, the current profile and migrated workbench recording still match their target hashes.

items.title: Delete protocol6 checkpoint and pre-authority recording converters
items.notes: Deleted checkpoint_upgrade_v6 and recording_upgrade_without_authority, prior Batch type, old-protocol validation/contract parameters and CLI legacy verifier flags. Current checkpoint value decoding remains shared by value/physics archives; generic application world/action conversion APIs remain.
validation: All 183 Replay network tests and the network wasm check pass. Current full-section checkpoint roundtrip uses nonempty actions/inputs/outcomes/bans/policy data, and validates rejection of unsupported protocol numbers with valid checksums.
Replay physical-archive generic/native regression suites and Godot import check pass after the shared decoder change; the native suite has 17 tests.
Current native/WASM recording fixtures verify without old models or converters. Generic conversion and action scheduling tests remain in the network suite.

items.title: Migrate C1-C8/O1-O2 fixtures and remove owned game conversion stacks
items.notes: Published all 18 migrated C9/O3 checkpoints after current decode, canonical byte roundtrip, exact full-frame digest and pending-action verification. Replaced old impact recordings with freshly captured current-model traces; preserved originals, producer sources and hashes as inert historical evidence. Deleted both Cave conversion stacks and migrated all active runners/docs to current fixtures.
validation: 35 Cave, 12 owner and 2 impact tests pass; impact fixtures execute in WASM, including event-only divergence detection.
15 saved fixtures resume with exact current full-frame hashes in fresh Godot processes. Floor, relic, carrier, accepted-pose and both impact runtime gates pass.
Definitions and lobby full gameplay/save/resume gates pass. Documentation and current Nix addon build pass.

items.title: Make bundle decoding require the bundle envelope; keep explicit raw checkpoint API
items.notes: Game bundle readers require the bundle envelope; removed implicit raw-checkpoint fallback. Current raw checkpoint APIs remain explicit for custom storage. No native raw game save requiring migration was present; retained standalone checkpoint fixtures use explicit SDK decoding.
validation: Pure test proves bundle acceptance, raw input rejection with an empty destination, and successful explicit raw checkpoint decoding.

Actual save/kill/fresh-resume gate passes and now rejects raw input, wrong identity and corruption while preserving rejected files. Its existing immediate-failure quit path emits deferred resource warnings; tracked for final journey qualification.

items.title: Rebuild affected examples/packages and finish removal/documentation checks
items.notes: Final Nix addon builds with patched pinned Odin and byte-matches current recovery, domain, bundle and setup sources. Replaced the whole installed Scrapyard SDK after preserving its old copy; verified removed checkpoint/recording upgrade files and play.Trail are absent. Original game rebuild/import, three-scene lifecycle, solo, two-peer join, profile persistence and host succession pass with no retries. Focused current Cave/Scrapyard archive/model/runtime checks and native/Web physics gates are recorded under their inventory areas. Independent final review found no missed authored callers and every registered suite script exists.
validation: Packaged SDK source/removal verification and full replacement receipt: /tmp/odin-usability-recovery-sdk-refresh.json.
Scrapyard lifecycle plus selected acts 0,1,5,9 pass with one attempt each: /tmp/odin-usability-recovery-scrapyard.log.
Current docs check resolves 196 pages and 19,889 references; production site build passes.
All 16 cleanup areas complete; earlier qualification limitations remain explicit and queued journey improvements stay in P2/P3.

retain: Generic replay/evolution and explicit checkpoint_convert/state/actions facilities, with small synthetic schema tests instead of obsolete game contracts.
Current value-only/custom composition: room_close_legacy, wire_receive_legacy, field-only lanes, primitive physics constructors, raw class-ID input and raw checkpoint APIs.
Current native memory-budget reconciliation exposed as legacy_extra; changing its name is optional and must preserve all admission/deduplication semantics.
Useful diagnostics rejecting old script prefixes/attributes; removing rejection alone can silently lose lifecycle callbacks.
Historical reports, frozen comparison sources and receipts when still meaningful evidence; no old gameplay decoder obligations inferred from retained evidence.
Owned/borrowed return lifetime choice, current type aliases and explicit feature negotiation that still serves supported behavior.
test_diagnosis: The old record migration test structs had equal padded sizes; replaced with genuinely different-size layouts and strict framing cases instead of preserving implicit coercion.
Removed WELCOME final-byte exemption and migrated typed-input fixtures instead of retaining historical fallback behavior.

An old motion fixture expected capacity failure at two joints. Current capacity is configurable (default256), so duplicate IDs now test Duplicate and MAX_JOINTS+1 tests Capacity. The Godot asset-boundary fixture now uses selected MAX_ASSETS+1 instead of the obsolete nine-asset threshold.

Initial Godot authoring runs were invoked with a static archive; corrected to the required shared library. Its old build manifest then correctly refused the changed capacity loader; rebuilt a new backend rather than editing provenance or weakening validation.

One-time settings verifier initially used an older Odin os.read_entire_file signature, then expected odin run to retain its executable. Corrected the validation tool to current allocator/error APIs and explicit build, then read back the installed file through current kit/save. Source settings stayed backed up; every field was verified.

Quickdraw WASM and owner scripts SIGSEGV failures were compiler defects: identical checker-worker stacks, default-threaded reproduction, and upstream shared-specialization mutation fix. Backported the exact fix to pinned Odin; 28 normal-threading probes and a permanent native/WASM generic-overload gate pass. See usability-compiler-evidence.json.

One-time migration initially needed unique frozen Odin package names and a real Audit_Capture owner for recording_verify; corrected the temporary tooling, then all19 candidates validated before publication.

The old popper correction fixture relied on legacy dash running before same-tick damage. With the current action path, moved contact later so the dash can be issued beforehand; retained the assertions that correction removes the blast, damage and flash.
Synthetic evolution fixture constants needed an addressable local array before slicing; corrected test setup without changing the API.

Independent review found that a gameplay content bump could make a successful catalog bake unreadable by the hardcoded stock decoder. Introduced one catalog semantic constant shared by baker/exporter/reader and regenerated artifact/receipt. Catalog value bytes/digest are unchanged.

Independent review found pending Ready was only checked at serialization. Strengthened continuation to require the ready-state change, settled sequence and exactly one result in both original/resumed servers.

New native motion test initially expected Incompatible for a format header mismatch; existing public contract returns Corrupt. Corrected the expected category while retaining empty-owner, unchanged-state and allocation checks.

The old semantic corruption fixture attempted to encode negative torque through the newly strict current scalar writer. Enabled scalar validation bypass only inside the OGB3_TESTING corruption generator; public read/write validation remains strict, and the invalid packet still must be rejected before native allocation.
limitations: Historical native user data found in the named projects was handled; browser-origin IndexedDB contents and arbitrary save-path overrides were not scanned. Current migrated browser recording fixtures were verified in WASM.

The existing Replay Scrapyard fail() calls SceneTree.quit immediately. Negative save rejection cases log deferred audio/resource cleanup warnings; fix/qualify this shutdown path before final journey completion.
Runtime editor/native qualification is on macOS. The compiler failure was diagnosed and fixed; native/WASM guards are registered for CI.
